verdict.rationale: Apple documents its own MLX framework explicitly for Apple silicon (apple-m4-max-docs-21) and Metal/PyTorch GPU-accelerated ML training support (apple-m4-max-docs-10, docs-12), covering GPU/NPU targeting for local AI workloads. Missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp or ONNX Runtime vendor documentation, and independent hands-on benchmarks confirming these local-AI runtimes perform well on M4 Max specifically.
